# Category illustration prompts
Generated with the built-in GPT Image tool, with transparent_background=true. Original output was resized to 512 × 512 PNG for the game, retaining transparency.

Each asset used the following prompt with its subject substituted:

> Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent category illustration for a cute party card game. Subject: {subject}. One simple centered isolated cartoon object/group, rounded chunky silhouette, clean hand-drawn dark forest-green outlines, flat soft pastel fills, minimal details, playful and charming, tiny dot eyes. Consistent sticker-like 2D illustration, no white sticker border. Square composition, entire object visible, generous transparent margin. No words, letters, numbers, watermark, scene, ground plane, gradients or photorealism. Genuine transparent background. Readable at 100 pixels.

- travel.png: a cute little butter-yellow suitcase with tiny coral wheels, a sage luggage tag and a tiny smiling face
- out.png: a cute coral pink roller skate with butter-yellow wheels and a tiny smiling face
- food.png: a cute peach pink bowl of noodles with two chopsticks, sage garnish and a tiny smiling face on the bowl
- everyday.png: a cute sage green little house with a coral roof and a tiny smiling face
- entertainment.png: a cute lilac game controller with butter-yellow buttons and a tiny smiling face
- habits.png: two cute overlapping peach and sage speech bubbles with little friendly faces
